metadata.name: Savings Tracker
metadata.description: A high-performance, standalone Windows desktop application for personal finance management, featuring multi-card bank ledgers with running balances, recurring subscription tracking with automated due-date catchup, savings plans with feasibility metrics, and native Windows toast notifications.

dependencies.dependency: Advanced UI controls including TableBuilder for spreadsheets
Date and time arithmetic and calendar calculations
Standard operating system directory paths resolution
Idiomatic error handling and context propagation
Native Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for interactive OS toast notifications

architecture.overview: Built around an immediate-mode UI paradigm where state is rendered and updated synchronously on every frame. State modifications trigger atomic disk persistence. The ledger engine computes running balances on demand from opening balances and chronological transactions, preventing state drift.

key_subsystems.subsystem: Silent, atomic JSON persistence to %APPDATA%\SavingsTracker\data.json using write-to-temp-and-rename semantics.
Chronological ordering and running balance computation with dynamic filtering (period, category, text search).
Automated time-travel catchup: advances overdue subscriptions and posts matching Money Out transactions when app launches.
Surplus evaluation, income vs expense feasibility calculations, overspending deduction, and deadline monitoring.
Dual-layer Windows notification pipeline (primary: Windows Runtime WinRT COM APIs; fallback: headless PowerShell script).
Embedded typography with Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (proportional body), and IBM Plex Mono (tabular monetary figures).

directory_structure.entry: Source code for core engine, models, and UI
User interface components, view controllers, and styling theme
Embedded TTF font binaries (SpaceGrotesk, Inter, IBMPlexMono)
Integration and unit tests verifying domain engines
Cargo package configuration, profiles, and dependencies
Project overview, build instructions, and design documentation

module.description: Defines all core business entities serialized to JSON. Includes default seed data for fresh installations.

Enum for recurrence: Monthly, Yearly, CustomDays(u32).
Recurring cost item linked to a card with next due date and pause status.
Financial goal with target, deadline, income, spending limits, and completion status.
Root application state containing cards, transactions, subscriptions, plans, and categories.

module.description: Manages loading and saving AppData from %APPDATA%\SavingsTracker\data.json. Employs atomic temp-file write and rename to ensure zero corruption on power outage or sudden termination.

structs.struct: Handles file system operations, directory creation, serialization, and deserialization.

Reads data.json or seeds default data if file is absent or corrupted.

module.role: Ledger and Running Balance Calculation Engine
module.description: Calculates chronological running balances per card starting from opening balance, and filters/sorts ledger rows based on active search queries, categories, and date ranges.

structs.struct: Renderable table row with money_in, money_out, running_balance, and opening balance flags.
Stateless utility computing and filtering full card ledgers.

methods.method: Chronologically sorts transactions and computes sequential running balance.
Filters rows by date range, category, and substring search, supporting reverse sort.

module.description: Calculates prorated monthly costs, advances billing cycles, and automatically catches up missed payment dates by recording Money Out transactions when the application launches.

structs.struct: Stateless helper for cycle math, proration, and due date resolution.

methods.method: Calculates the next due date based on Monthly, Yearly, or CustomDays cycle.
Computes normalized monthly cost (divides yearly by 12, scales custom days).
Aggregates prorated monthly commitments across all or selected cards.
Loops through overdue active subscriptions, creates ledger expenses, and advances dates.

module.role: Savings Plan Calculations and Expiration Tracking
module.description: Evaluates financial feasibility of target savings against monthly income and subscription burdens. Tracks monthly spending vs recommended limits to calculate historical surplus and triggers toast notifications on plan deadline.

structs.struct: Monthly breakdown of income, spending limit, actual spending, and surplus/deficit.
Computed plan progress, required monthly savings, feasibility status, and projected shortage.
Engine for metric evaluation, historical progress tracking, and deadline expiration handling.

methods.method: Computes normalized months remaining until deadline.
Calculates required monthly savings and recommended discretionary spending limit.
Evaluates actual monthly expenditures from linked cards against plan limits.
Checks active plans against system date, archives expired plans, and triggers toast notifications.

module.description: Dispatches native Windows 10/11 toast notifications. Uses windows-rs WinRT APIs directly, with a silent fallback to headless PowerShell invocation for maximum cross-environment compatibility.

functions.function: Primary dispatcher attempting WinRT first, falling back to PowerShell.
Constructs XML toast payload and calls ToastNotificationManager.
Spawns a hidden PowerShell process executing WinRT notification commands.

types.type: Enum representing the 3 main views: Accounts, Subscriptions, SavingsPlans.
Root application state holding active tab, view states, storage, and notice queue.

functions.function: Main rendering entry for the Subscriptions tab.

test_file.description: Automated test suite verifying domain logic, formatting, and mathematical guarantees.

tests.test: Verifies comma grouping, whole/decimal formatting, and parse_pkr_input for Pakistani Rupee amounts.
Verifies chronological sequencing, backdated edits, and balance math starting from opening balance.
Verifies that exactly one opening balance anchor row is synthesized for any card.
Verifies date progression and prorated monthly expense calculations.
Verifies automatic catchup generation for overdue recurring subscriptions.
Verifies feasibility detection when targets exceed monthly income.
Verifies monthly spending against limits and net surplus calculation.
Verifies atomic disk writes, temp file cleanup, and data recovery.
Verifies custom font families, glyph availability, and table layout generation.
End-to-end integration test verifying opening balance persistence, backdating, and comma parsing.
